name: Jonas Reell
desire: to be left in the silence he chose, and forgiven without having to confess
need: to hand the weight to someone who will carry it as he did, not to be absolved
values: the sea's verdict over the district's paperwork
fears: that restoring the relay will kill the next crew
that he was only ever a coward dressed as a savior
contradictions: kept meticulous logs while committing the one act he never logged
deflects yet corrected the tide table so the next operator would be safe
beliefs: the chart is wrong and no one will pay to prove it
some rescues are executions with better lighting
knowledge: that he cut the relay and why
that the chart mis-marks the reef
constraints: no proof of the mis-survey that a district would accept

lexicon: answers a question with a question
